thread:
tanya: Cutting RC for feature-flags-service sha=fa7b2c1. Opening RC. Change window 2026-03-27 01:00-03:00 UTC. Need QA + sherpa for canary.

releng: RC created id=4620. Artifacts pinned: feature-flags:fa7b2c1. Promote to canary with `/deploy promote rc/4620 --env canary --percent 5 --kv-warm`. Release note draft posted.

ben: quick staging smoke looks fine, small warning about cache-miss spike during cold start.

qa: pasted trace snippet: ```text
2026-03-26T20:04:12Z WARN cache miss key=ff:12345
2026-03-26T20:04:12Z INFO fetching from primary
```

sheriff-ops: i'm on for the window. Pre-approved rollback target: feature-flags:de9a1f0. Rollback cmd ready: `kubectl set image deploy/feature-flags feature-flags=de9a1f0 -n prod`

tanya: promoting to canary 5% now. `/deploy promote rc/4620 --env canary --percent 5 --kv-warm`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion started rc/4620 -> canary (5%). KV warm in progress (60s).

ben: KV warm complete. canary smoke ok, miss spike normal for first minute then stabilizes. error rate flat.

qa: hold 10m. if errors >0.8% for 3m we abort.

tanya: starting prod ramp: `/deploy promote rc/4620 --env prod --stages 10,50,100 --wait-metrics`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Prod ramp started -> stage 10%. Notifying oncall.

sheriff-ops: seeing a small uptick in upstream 503s at 10% stage. threshold hit at 01:12 UTC. Recommend pause and quick triage.

tanya: pausing at 10% now. `/deploy abort-stage rc/4620 --reason "upstream_503 uptick"`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Ramp paused at 10%. Reason: metric(upstream_503) breached threshold.

ben: quick grep shows spikes in cache warm calls to primary (latency 800ms) causing timeouts on heavy paths. No OOMs. Heap and threads look fine.

qa: options: (1) rollback to de9a1f0, (2) reduce prod traffic and apply cache-prefill job, (3) tune timeout on a short lived proxy. Which is fastest?

sheriff-ops: prefer non-deploy mitigation first. If a cache-prefill job can run quickly, do that. Otherwise rollback.

tanya: run prefill job now. Command: `/jobs run cache-prefill --keys recent-100k --target feature-flags:fa7b2c1`

releng: job started, streaming logs. ETA ~90s to fill hot keys.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Cache-prefill job completed. Observability: primary cache hit rate improved.

ben: after prefill, upstream 503s dropped to baseline within 2 mins. Looks stable at 10%.

qa: continuing ramp with 50% stage but keep 15m hold. `/deploy promote rc/4620 --env prod --resume --stages 50,100`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Resuming promotion: moving to 50%.

sheriff-ops: monitoring. If 5xx >1% for 5m we abort.

ops: at ~50% we see a new error class: feature-eval mismatch causing 400s for a small subset of clients (0.4%). Details: `ERROR eval mismatch id=ff-xyz expected=on got=off`

ben: that indicates a serialization edge with older clients. Risk small but I'm not comfortable continuing to 100% until we patch. Recommend rollback.

tanya: agree. execute rollback to de9a1f0 for prod. @sheriff-ops please run rollback.

sheriff-ops: issuing rollback: `kubectl set image deploy/feature-flags feature-flags=de9a1f0 -n prod && /deploy resume --target rc/4620 --action rollback`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback initiated. Routing prod traffic back to feature-flags:de9a1f0. Monitoring healthchecks.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback complete: prod now running feature-flags:de9a1f0. Health checks green; error rates back to baseline.

qa: post-rollback smoke: client 400s gone, cache hit stable.

ben: filing bug: serialization compatibility fix + added regression test for mixed-client evals. Will re-cut RC after fix.

tanya: postmortem note: "RC 4620: initial cache coldness caused transient 503s mitigated by cache-prefill; later client eval serialization mismatch at 50% triggered rollback. Action: add prefill to rollout playbook and fix serialization; re-cut RC after tests." Assigned to @ben.

sheriff-ops: closing watch. :white_check_mark:
